episode_summary: Barely Informed News delivers a chaotic midweek broadcast: Hype Train opens with graphic train-reproduction freestyle, Case and Rick clash over Iran ceasefire talks and massive US troop deployments, Jeb teaches watermelon steak grilling and Kundalini chanting from a Thai fairy hut, Crum and Munch debate Trump vs Biden OnlyFans viability, news covers Live Nation's monopoly loss and RFK Jr.'s raccoon-penis diary, Grandma Crumble Bottom joins Amongst the Web to reveal crypto gains, Trip Bradstein interviews park denizens including a washing-machine void victim, and Brandon crashes the studio PC attempting his first Fortnite stream after a Saudi Arabia ban.
